# Made-up organization: not real data

Every engineer, team and session in this Grafana was invented by `scripts/made-up.sh`, to see and check Cardo's views on an organization's worth of data ([ADR-0051](https://github.com/amanachenko/cardo/blob/main/docs/adr/0051-a-made-up-organization.md)).

- It shows whether a chart shows what was planted. It cannot show whether a signal means anything with real people.
- Nothing seen here is a finding about Claude Code, about engineers or about any organization.
- The dashboards are in the folder **MADE-UP ORGANIZATION - not real data**. Open them from **Dashboards**.
